title: Recreation Center Pool
transcript: Hi, everyone, this is an update from the recreation center. The indoor pool will be closed for the next ten days so that the water filters can be replaced. During that time, the outdoor pool will open an hour earlier, at six a.m., for lap swimming only. Swim lessons are postponed, and instructors will email participants with new dates. The gym and fitness rooms are not affected.

questions.stem: What will happen to swim lessons during the closure?
options: They will move to the outdoor pool
They will be canceled for the semester
They will be held in the gym
They will be rescheduled for later dates
questions.explanation: Swim lessons are postponed, and instructors will email new dates.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To introduce a new fitness room
To inform users about a temporary closure
To explain how water filters work
questions.explanation: The speaker explains that the indoor pool will be closed for ten days and what alternatives exist.
